trips.purpose: Philadelphia Catholic Collaborators / Becket Fund meeting and Gala / Ward Fitzgerald event hold
notes: Overview: Melissa is joining; Philadelphia trip runs Wednesday Jun 10 through Saturday Jun 13.

Hotel: Canopy by Hilton Philadelphia Center City, 1180 Ludlow Street, Philadelphia, PA 19107. Check-in starts 4:00 PM Wednesday; checkout is by 12:00 PM Saturday. Phone: +1 215-258-9400. Hilton page: https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/phloppy-canopy-philadelphia-center-city/.

Wed Jun 10: Jason flies FWA-ORD-PHL early and is scheduled to arrive PHL at 9:40 AM. Hotel check-in starts at 4:00 PM. Melissa's outbound is still unconfirmed in Jason iCloud, but the working option arrives PHL around 4:50/4:53 PM for the 6:00 PM Barnes Foundation Reception.

Wed Jun 10: Becket Barnes Foundation Reception, 6:00-9:30 PM at The Barnes Foundation, 2025 Benjamin Franklin Parkway. Dress: smart casual. Outdoor terrace reception with light buffet, beverages, desserts, and private Barnes Collection viewing from 6:30-8:00 PM. Security and bag inspection; larger bags/coats must be checked.

Thu Jun 11: Becket President's Luncheon & Legal Briefing, 11:30 AM-1:30 PM at The Union League Club, 140 South Broad Street. Dress: business casual; no sneakers or jeans. Use the Broad Street entrance; buffet begins at 11:30 AM, briefing at noon.

Thu Jun 11: Becket Canterbury Medal Gala, 6:00-11:00 PM at the National Constitution Center, 525 Arch Street. Dress: black tie. Pre-registration required; free parking in museum garage; metal detectors and bag inspection on entry.
Fri Jun 12: Archbishop Nelson's Birthday Dinner is confirmed for 7:30 PM at Sang Kee Asian Bistro, 339 E Lancaster Ave, Unit 6, Wynnewood, PA 19096.

Sat Jun 13: Jason returns PHL-CLT-FWA, departing PHL at 12:07 PM and arriving FWA at 5:14 PM. Hotel checkout is available until noon, but the flight timing means airport departure will need to be earlier.
Packing/logistics: Melissa should plan carry-on only because the Wednesday transfer is tight. Jason plans to check bags.
Jason flight confirmation found in personal iCloud: American confirmation is on file with Clive; do not publish booking/payment details publicly.
Jason booked outbound: Wed Jun 10 AA6208 FWA-ORD 5:25 AM-5:35 AM, seat 7B; AA2115 ORD-PHL 6:29 AM-9:40 AM, seat 13A.
Jason booked return: Sat Jun 13 AA1311 PHL-CLT 12:07 PM-2:00 PM; AA6078 CLT-FWA 3:19 PM-5:14 PM, seat 8B. This replaces the earlier assumed 10:30 AM PHL-CLT option.
